current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Strong verbal reasoning and oral calculation. / 口語邏輯及心算能力強。
current_performance.weaknesses: (Mild) Reverses similar-looking numbers (e.g., 6 and 9, 12 and 21) and reads slowly. / (輕度) 常寫反相似數字（如6和9，12和21），閱讀速度較慢。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Highlight key numbers and math terms in word problems. Allow 15% extra time. / 在應用題中用螢光筆標示關鍵字和數字，給予15%額外時間。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Phonics and decoding training in resource class. / 資源班進行語音及拆字訓練。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Praise effort rather than speed to reduce reading anxiety. / 讚揚其付出的努力而非速度，以減輕閱讀焦慮。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Excellent visual-spatial skills, good at geometry. / 視覺空間能力優異，擅長圖形與空間。
current_performance.weaknesses: (Moderate) Extremely poor working memory for multi-step word problems. Forgets the first part of a sentence by the time he reaches the end. / (中度) 處理多步驟應用題時工作記憶極弱，讀到句尾會忘記句首內容。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Break down word problems into single, isolated sentences. Use Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract (CPA) models to bypass text. / 將應用題拆解為單一獨立句子。使用「具體-圖像-抽象」(CPA) 模型來避開繁重文字。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Working memory training strategies with SENCO. / 與特殊教育統籌主任進行工作記憶策略訓練。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Check for understanding frequently before he starts working. / 在他開始作答前，頻密檢查其是否理解指示。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Enjoys collaborative work and hands-on activities. / 喜歡小組合作和動手做的活動。
current_performance.weaknesses: (Severe) Severe visual tracking issues. Skips lines when reading and experiences high visual fatigue with standard worksheets. / (嚴重) 嚴重的視覺追蹤困難，閱讀時常跳行，面對一般工作紙極易產生視覺疲勞。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Enlarge text (Size 16+), double line spacing, and use reading rulers. Teacher or peer must read instructions aloud. / 放大字體（16號或以上），雙倍行距，使用閱讀尺。教師或同儕須朗讀指示。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Use text-to-speech software for assessments. / 評估時使用文字轉語音軟件。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Pair with a supportive peer reader during group work. / 在小組活動時安排一位具支援性的朋輩伴讀。
social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Counseling to manage low academic self-esteem. / 輔導以處理低落的學業自信心。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Understands math concepts quickly, strong logical thinking. / 能快速理解數學概念，邏輯思維強。
current_performance.weaknesses: Poor fine motor skills. Handwriting is illegible, and he cannot align numbers vertically for column addition. / 小肌肉發展較弱。字體難以辨認，無法將數字對齊以進行直式加減運算。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Provide grid paper with large boxes to help align numbers. Allow oral answers for simple calculations. / 提供大格子的網格紙協助對齊數字。簡單運算允許口頭作答。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Occupational therapy for fine motor skills. / 職業治療以訓練小肌肉技巧。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Do not penalize for untidy handwriting if the logic is correct. / 若邏輯正確，不因字體潦草而扣分。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Highly creative and energetic. / 具高度創意，精力充沛。
current_performance.weaknesses: (Hyperactive-Impulsive) Leaves seat frequently, fidgets constantly, and blurts out answers before thinking. / (過度活躍/衝動型) 經常離座、坐立不安，未經思考便搶答。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Incorporate movement breaks. Allow standing at desk to work. / 融入活動小休，允許站在桌旁完成工作。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Use token economy system for remaining on task. / 使用代幣制獎勵其持續專注。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Teach hand-raising rules and praise immediately when he waits his turn. / 教導舉手發言規則，當他能輪候時立即給予讚賞。
social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Behavioral management group training. / 行為管理小組訓練。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Good memory, interested in logic puzzles. / 記憶力好，對邏輯解謎感興趣。
current_performance.weaknesses: (Inattentive) Daydreams easily, misses oral instructions, and struggles to initiate tasks. / (注意力不足型) 容易發白日夢，常錯過口頭指示，難以開始動手做功課。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Seat in front row near teacher. Use physical/visual cues to regain attention before giving instructions. / 安排坐在前排近教師位置。給予指示前使用肢體或視覺提示以吸引其注意。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Provide an individualized step-by-step checklist on his desk. / 在其桌上提供個人化的逐步完成清單。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Use non-verbal cues (like tapping desk) to gently redirect attention. / 使用非語言提示（如輕敲桌面）溫和地重新引導其專注力。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Very fast processor, understands concepts instantly. / 訊息處理速度極快，能瞬間理解概念。
current_performance.weaknesses: (Combined) Rushes through work, makes numerous careless calculation errors. / (混合型) 做事過急，常犯大量粗心大意的運算錯誤。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Cover parts of the worksheet to limit focus to one question at a time. Teach self-checking routines. / 遮擋部分工作紙以限制其每次只專注一題，教導自我檢查的常規。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Reduce written workload to ensure quality over quantity. / 減少抄寫功課量，重質不重量。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Assign the role of distributing materials to channel excess energy purposefully. / 安排派發物資的角色，有目的地引導其過剩精力。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Excellent rote calculation skills, loves patterns and rules. / 機械式運算能力極佳，喜歡規律和法則。
current_performance.weaknesses: Highly rigid thinking. Panics if the lesson flow changes unexpectedly or if asked to solve a problem using a 'new' method. / 思維極度固執。若課堂流程突然改變，或被要求用「新」方法解題時會感到恐慌。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Provide a clear visual schedule. Explicitly explain the connection between 'old' methods and 'new' methods before transitioning. / 提供清晰的視覺日程。在過渡前，明確解釋「舊」方法與「新」方法之間的關聯。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Use social stories to prepare for changes in routine. / 運用社交故事為常規轉變作準備。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Give warning 5 minutes before transitioning to a new activity. Keep group work roles highly structured. / 轉換活動前5分鐘給予預告。保持小組工作的角色具高度結構性。
social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Social skills training group. / 社交技巧訓練小組。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Highly imaginative, strong in visual arts; good at direct single-step calculations. / 富有想像力，視覺藝術能力強；擅長直接計算單一步驟算題。
current_performance.weaknesses: Weak working memory, struggling to hold multiple calculation steps in mind; easily overwhelmed by multi-sentence text problems. / 工作記憶較弱，難以在腦中同時處理多個計算步驟；面對多句組成的文字題容易失去方向。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Use clear visual flowcharts (step-by-step checklists) to demonstrate problem-solving; reduce question density per worksheet page with ample white space. / 運用步驟分明的視覺流程圖（例如分步清單）展示解題過程；每頁工作紙減少題目密度，留白清晰。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Apply Chunking by displaying only one calculation step at a time before revealing the next; provide grid scratch paper to record intermediate steps and reduce memory load. / 採用「分段學習法 (Chunking)」，每次只呈現一個計算步驟，完成後再顯示下一步；提供草稿方格紙協助記錄中間算式，減輕記憶負荷。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Seat her near the front-center for close teacher monitoring; provide immediate verbal encouragement when she loses track to prevent giving up, and allow her to sketch her thought process. / 安排坐在課室前排中央以方便老師觀察進度；在她因忘記步驟而想放棄時，給予即時口頭鼓勵，並容許她以繪畫方式表達解題思路。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Very active, good at sports; strong spatial reasoning and motivated by score-based challenges. / 非常活躍，擅長體育運動；空間推理能力強，喜歡計分挑戰。
current_performance.weaknesses: Impulsive when answering and easily distracted by cluttered layouts; frequently overlooks symbols or skips steps during calculation. / 作答較衝動，容易被版面雜亂的資訊分散注意力；計算時經常看漏符號或數漏步驟。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Use clean, distraction-free layouts with oversized, color-coded operation symbols (+, -); keep classroom instructions brief, giving only 1–2 steps at a time. / 採用簡潔、低干擾的教材版面，並放大及以鮮明顏色標示運算符號（+、-）；課堂指令簡短直接，每次只給予一至兩個步驟。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Break exercises into short micro-tasks (e.g., immediate feedback or mini-break every 3 questions); provide a "Check-the-Sign" checklist reminding him to circle symbols before solving. / 將練習切分為短時段的小任務（如每完成 3 題小休或獲即時回饋）；提供「審題檢查表」提醒他先圈出符號再作答。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Seat him away from windows and doors to minimize distractions; use an immediate positive reinforcement system (points/stickers) for on-task behavior, and assign brief movement tasks (e.g., distributing manipulatives) to channel energy constructively. / 安排遠離窗邊及門口的位置以減少外界干擾；運用即時正向獎勵制度（如積分或貼紙）強化專注行為，並安排短暫的課堂小任務（如派發教具）讓他合法釋放精力。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Good at science experiments, highly sociable, strong auditory memory. / 擅長科學實驗，樂於社交，聽覺記憶力強。
current_performance.weaknesses: Weak visual discrimination, often confusing similar-looking digits or reversing place values; relies on concrete visuals to grasp abstract quantities. / 視覺辨識較弱，容易混淆形狀相似的數字或將兩位數的數位倒轉；需要具體圖像輔助才能理解抽象數量。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Use high-contrast, large, non-mirror sans-serif fonts; pair abstract numbers with concrete manipulatives and pictorial icons (CPA approach). / 採用高對比、大字體及不易混淆的無襯線字型；結合具體教具（如數粒、積木）與圖像（CPA 模式）展示抽象數量。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Provide color-coded Tens/Ones place-value mats to prevent digit reversal; reduce copying demands by using multiple-choice (MCQ) or oral responses, leveraging her auditory memory with math rhymes/chants. / 提供「十位／個位」顏色分欄表以防數位倒轉；減少抄寫要求，改以選擇題（MCQ）或口頭作答，善用其聽覺記憶優勢配合口訣學習。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Leverage her sociability through collaborative group problem-solving where she can verbalize concepts; avoid harsh red-pen markings and gently prompt her to self-check digit orientation. / 善用她樂於社交的特質，安排小組合作解題活動，讓她透過口頭討論鞏固概念；老師批改時避免只用紅筆圈錯，改以溫和提示引導她自我檢查數字方向。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Clear logical thinking, sensitive to number patterns and sequences, strong memory. / 邏輯思維清晰，對數字規律及排序敏感，記憶力出眾。
current_performance.weaknesses: Prefers predictable question formats and struggles with abstract story contexts; countdown timers or harsh error prompts easily trigger anxiety. / 偏好固定及可預測的題目格式，較難理解抽象情境故事；面對倒數計時或嚴厲的錯誤提示容易產生焦慮。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Maintain highly consistent, predictable lesson routines and worksheet layouts; use literal, direct language instead of metaphors or complex story contexts. / 保持課堂流程與教材排版高度一致及可預測；以清晰、直白的語言取代隱喻或複雜的情境故事。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Remove countdown timers and harsh error sounds/red "X"s in digital tools and tests, replacing them with neutral, encouraging prompts; provide structured worked examples in advance before introducing new question formats. / 學習軟件及測驗中移除倒數計時器與嚴厲的錯誤音效／紅交叉，改用中性鼓勵提示；在引入新題型前，先提供結構化的例題作預告。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Give advance notice of any routine changes and provide a designated "calm-down corner" for emotional regulation; assign him a clear, predictable role in group work (e.g., checking number patterns) to reduce social ambiguity. / 預先告知課堂轉變（如轉組或新活動），並設立課室「冷靜角」供情緒緊張時短暫調節；小組活動中明確分配他的固定角色（如負責核對答案規律），減少社交不確定性。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Keen observer, excels at visual matching and categorization; diligent learner. / 觀察力敏銳，擅長圖像配對及分類；學習態度認真。
current_performance.weaknesses: Limited vocabulary, struggling with long sentences and comparative math terms; needs visual support to translate verbal descriptions into equations. / 詞彙量有限，理解長句及比較類數學詞彙有困難；需要圖像輔助才能將文字描述轉化為算式。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Speak at a measured pace and pair comparative math terms (e.g., "more than", "fewer than") with side-by-side visual icons; use simple subject-verb-object (SVO) sentences. / 教學時放慢語速，將比較類詞彙（如「多於」、「少於」）配合具體圖示並列呈現；板書及教材採用簡短主謂賓（SVO）句式。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Provide an illustrated "Math Vocabulary Bank"; pre-teach core math terms before lessons, and allow image-matching or tap-to-select options instead of written verbal explanations. / 提供圖文對照的「數學詞彙表」；課前預習核心數學詞彙，練習時容許以配對圖像或點選選項取代書寫文字解釋。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Provide extended wait time after asking questions without rushing or interrupting; encourage participation through gestures, pointing to visuals, or short phrases, and consistently affirm her diligence. / 提問後給予額外的思考與回應時間（Wait Time），不催促或打斷她的表達；鼓勵她以手勢、指認圖像或簡短詞語參與課堂互動，並肯定她的認真態度。

current_performance.strengths_and_interests: Excellent at rote counting and simple mental math; enjoys drawing and building blocks. / 擅長唱數及簡單心算；喜歡畫畫及砌積木。
current_performance.weaknesses: Low reading fluency with frequent word omissions; difficulty identifying mathematical keywords in word problems. / 閱讀流暢度不足，讀題時經常漏字；難以辨識應用題中的數學關鍵詞。

learning_adjustment.tier_1_support: Use short sentence structures in class materials with color-coded math keywords; provide visual aids to support comprehension. / 課堂教材採用簡短句式，並以不同顏色標示數學關鍵詞（如加、減詞彙）；提供圖像輔助理解題意。
learning_adjustment.tier_2_and_3_support: Provide text-to-speech/read-aloud support and a "Keyword Cue Card"; offer extra time and read-aloud accommodations during assessments, breaking long word problems into short clauses. / 提供讀屏／語音讀題支援及「關鍵詞提示卡」；測考時給予加時及讀題安排，並將長應用題拆分為短句。

social_behavioral_adjustment.tier_1_support: Avoid asking him to read long word problems aloud in front of the class to prevent frustration; pair him with a supportive reading buddy and praise his mental math speed and drawing talent to build confidence. / 避免要求他在全班面前朗讀長文字題目以減少挫敗感；安排與樂於助人的同儕作伴讀，並多讚賞他的心算速度與繪畫天份以建立自信。
